To play it, set the tempo first, learn the left-hand pattern alone, then add the melody hands together, keeping the strong beats steady. The song is presented whole: every bar, every note, and the full structure, with nothing truncated and nothing preview-only. It is an original genre study in the public musical language of piano rock: the progression, rhythm, and form are shared genre vocabulary, and the melody is newly composed for this record. It is not any existing copyrighted song, and it reproduces no copyrighted melody, lyric, or recording.

body: This is a complete original piano rock piano song in E minor at 108 beats per minute in 4/4 time, built on the rock-and-roll framework across 32 bars in the form A B A Coda. The left hand carries the harmonic framework, playing the progression bar by bar, while the right hand carries a newly composed melody that moves stepwise with occasional leaps, staying inside the genre scale. To play it, set the tempo first, learn the left-hand pattern alone, then add the melody hands together, keeping the strong beats steady. The song is presented whole: every bar, every note, and the full structure, with nothing truncated and nothing preview-only. It is an original genre study in the public musical language of piano rock: the progression, rhythm, and form are shared genre vocabulary, and the melody is newly composed for this record. It is not any existing copyrighted song, and it reproduces no copyrighted melody, lyric, or recording.
